scope: All 36 selected tasks, all 324 accepted attempts, across Leon/OpenClaw/Hermes
gate: No PinchBench environment, preflight or candidate begins until the completed Wild cohort has a current accepted contextual fairness review.
checks: Three accepted attempts per agent and task, with symmetric inclusion/exclusion and exact frozen selection.
Frozen agent versions, direct subscription authentication, Sol/high/priority requests and actual returned tiers.
Task inputs, task-guide visibility, native tools and required capability/configuration access; distinguish intended native differences from adapter omissions.
Published task budgets, resources, isolation and concurrency exposure.
Zero/low scores, missing outputs, timeouts, native/provider errors and network interruptions.
Native grader paths, exported artifacts, transcript completeness, replay receipts and unsupported/fallback judging.
Contextual review of known Misinformation wording/negation limitations, plus suspicious high scores and objective grader blind spots.
outcome_policy: Retain genuine native failures. Preserve all evidence. Repair confirmed environment/grader defects and rerun only affected attempts where justified; exclude compromised matched tasks consistently while unresolved. Frozen task substitutions require explicit owner approval.
